No FAIL clause fires because no flow outside the scope appears on any model. One expected signal is missing: the turn 3 model's `Left out:` lines name only in-scope gaps and never name signup and billing, so a grader applying every-signal strictness could read this as FAIL. The driver's adaptive turn shifted the script by one turn, so the scripted "go ahead with that scope" answered the playback and the final scripted line arrived at the write gate. That shift is a harness fact, and the model handled it correctly by not treating a reading confirmation as a write yes
